description: Traverse the Finch Vault knowledge graph - get all entries linked to a given entry. Returns both outbound links (entries this entry references) and inbound links (entries that reference this one). Filter by relation type to find only derived entries, superseded versions, continuations, etc.

key.description: Entry key to find related entries for

relation.description: Filter to only this relation type (omit for all relations)

name: vault_related
